subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this export command and grouped portable-package identity as part of the experimental Claws lifecycle before the draft RFC and prerequisite stack are accepted?
rationale: Code review can assess the implementation, but automation cannot decide whether core should establish this new CLI and portable package contract or what compatibility commitment its experimental status implies.

options.title: Approve after RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the PR draft and land it only after maintainers accept the grouped Claw model and its prerequisite lifecycle stack.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Approve a smaller export surface while deferring recorded package identity or full lifecycle round-trip guarantees.

options.title: Pause the export slice
options.body: Defer or close this slice if maintainers do not want grouped Claw packaging to become a core product surface.

recommendation.title: Approve after RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft and land it only after maintainers accept the grouped Claw model and its prerequisite lifecycle stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They have supplied the most direct product-model and implementation review evidence for this export contract.
